description: Presentation data for the language-coverage map. LocaleAccess supplies relevance candidates; profiles distinguish country-wide languages from regional languages and tune approximate spread and framing.

viewpoint_resolution_model.description: A feature may resolve differently for different access-country viewpoints. selection_countries controls the result of clicking the feature; level controls its visual status. The first matching viewpoints entry wins, otherwise the default entry is used.

levels.administered: Treat the resolved selection as effectively administered and mask underlying country geometry.
levels.recognized: Present only the resolved selection as recognized for this viewpoint, masking competing claims without asserting effective administration.
levels.claimed: Treat the resolved selection as a non-administered claim.
levels.observed: Use admin_countries and the ordinary observed-control rendering.
levels.unclaimed: Assign the feature to no country and render it as unclaimed.
levels.hidden: Do not present the feature for this viewpoint.

israel_nonrecognizing_states.description: UN member states that do not formally recognize the State of Israel; used to suppress Israel's disputed territorial claim layers, not Israel itself.

guyana_essequibo_supporting_states.description: States with an explicit official or collective position supporting Guyana's sovereignty or territorial integrity in the Essequibo controversy; used only for the Guayana Esequiba overlay.
